tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Searches the Pandus library of accessibility rule cards (the axe-core rules Pandus checks, explained for business owners) by words, an axe rule id or a WCAG success criterion such as 1.4.3. Free, no API token needed.

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Explains one accessibility rule (an axe-core rule id such as image-alt or color-contrast): what is wrong, why it matters for customers, who is affected, how to fix it in code and on Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop or Shoptet, and the WCAG 2.2 / EN 301 549 clauses. Free, no API token needed.

tools.name: explain_wcag_criterion
tools.description: Explains a WCAG 2.2 level A or AA success criterion (for example 2.4.7) in plain words: what it asks, examples, how to test it by hand and what automated checks can and cannot find. Free, no API token needed.
